definition_en: to bring things or people together from different places, often carefully and one by one
core_image: 把散在各处的东西一件件拢到自己面前
scene: 邮票散落在桌子各处，哥哥把它们一张张夹进册子。My brother began to collect stamps from all over the world last year.
sceneCN: 这里 collect 是「收集」（第 1 个义项：把东西聚拢）；句意是哥哥从去年开始收集世界各地的邮票。

derivatives.zh: 由 collect 加 -ion 构成，义为「收集品；收藏；采集」
由 collect 加 -or 构成，义为「收集者；收藏家」
由 collect 加 -ive 构成，义为「集体的；共同的」

senses.title: To bring things together
senses.definition: to gather things from different places and keep them together
senses.definitionCN: 把散在不同地方的东西聚拢到一起保存
senses.example: The class began to collect old books for the library.
senses.exampleCN: 全班开始为图书馆收集旧书。
senses.why: The prefix col- means together and lect means gather, so the word pictures pulling things into one pile.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 col- 表示「一起」，lect 表示「聚集」，词义就是把东西拉到一堆。

senses.title: To gather people together
senses.definition: to bring people together in one place
senses.definitionCN: 把人聚集到同一个地方
senses.example: The teacher collected the students in the playground.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把学生集合在操场上。
senses.why: Gathering works for people as well as things, so the word widened to groups of persons.
senses.whyCN: 聚集既能用于物也能用于人，词义便扩展到人群。

senses.title: To go and get something waiting for you
senses.definition: to go somewhere and take away something or someone kept for you
senses.definitionCN: 去某个地方把为你保管的东西或人带走
senses.example: Please collect your test papers at the front desk.
senses.exampleCN: 请到前台领取你们的试卷。
senses.why: What has been gathered is kept somewhere, and taking it back is the last step of collecting.
senses.whyCN: 被聚拢的东西会被保管在某处，取回它就是收集的最后一步。

senses.title: To get money or rent
senses.definition: to obtain money that is owed or given, often for a group
senses.definitionCN: 把欠的或捐的钱收上来
senses.example: Students collect money for the sports meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们为运动会筹款。
senses.why: Money also needs to be brought together from many people, so the same verb fits.
senses.whyCN: 钱也需要从许多人那里聚到一起，同一个动词便沿用下来。

senses.title: To calm oneself
senses.definition: to calm yourself and focus before doing something hard
senses.definitionCN: 在做事之前让自己平静下来、集中精神
senses.example: She took a deep breath to collect herself before the speech.
senses.exampleCN: 演讲前她深呼吸让自己镇定下来。
senses.why: Collecting your thoughts is like collecting papers: everything scattered is put in order.
senses.whyCN: 整理思绪就像收试卷：把散乱的东西归置整齐。

intro.en: Collect means to gather together, built on Latin roots.
intro.cn: collect 的意思是「聚到一起」，由拉丁词根搭成。

items.en: Latin legere meant to gather or pick out, and com- added the idea of together.
items.cn: 拉丁语 legere 意为收集、挑选，前缀 com- 加上了「一起」的意思。

items.en: Latin colligere meant to gather together into one.
items.cn: 拉丁语 colligere 意为聚拢到一处。

items.en: Old French collecter and collecte passed the gathering idea on.
items.cn: 古法语 collecter、collecte 把「聚集」的意思传了下来。

items.en: Middle English collecten first named gathering money in church.
items.cn: 中古英语 collecten 最初指在教堂里募捐收钱。

items.en: Modern English collect grew into study, rubbish, tickets and people.
items.cn: 现代英语 collect 的用法扩展到收藏、垃圾、取票和集合人群。

note.en: The first group collects words with the same root lect; the second collects words close in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组收同一词根 lect 的词，第二组收近义词。

entries.definition: A group of things gathered together.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「收藏品；收集」，是 collect 的名词形式。
名词，义为「收藏家；收集者」，与 collect 同根。
动词，义为「选举」，含同一词根 lect（挑选）。
动词，义为「挑选」，同根词。

entries.definition: To bring things or people together.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「聚集；收集」，与 collect 意思相近但更口语。

entries.definition: To gather people or parts together.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「集合；装配」，较正式。

entries.definition: To collect more and more over time.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「积累」，强调逐渐变多。

normalIntro.en: Remember collect through its Latin parts and its everyday jobs.
normalIntro.cn: 从拉丁词根与日常用途两个角度记 collect。

normal.en: col- means together and -lect means gather.
normal.cn: col- 表示一起，-lect 表示聚集。

normal.en: select, elect and collect share the root.
normal.cn: select、elect 和 collect 同词根。

normal.en: Rubbish trucks collect rubbish every morning.
normal.cn: 垃圾车每天早上收垃圾。

normal.en: Collect your ticket before boarding the train.
normal.cn: 上火车前先取票。

normal.en: A stamp collector keeps stamps in an album.
normal.cn: 集邮者把邮票收在册子里。

abstract.en: Picture scattered leaves being swept into one pile.
abstract.cn: 想象散落的树叶被扫成一堆。

abstract.en: See hands from many places placing coins in one box.
abstract.cn: 想象许多只手把硬币放进同一个箱子。

abstract.en: Feel a deep breath pulling your thoughts into order.
abstract.cn: 感觉一次深呼吸把思绪理顺。

examples.en: We collect waste paper every Friday to keep the school clean.
examples.cn: 每周五我们都收集废纸保持校园整洁。

examples.en: Remember to collect your new uniform from the office.
examples.cn: 记得去办公室领取你的新校服。

examples.en: Playing the piano helps her collect her thoughts.
examples.cn: 弹钢琴帮助她集中思绪。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扩来摭」——把散落四边的东西都「扩来摭」到一起，collect 就是收集。

root: 拉丁语 com-（一起）+ legere（收集、挑选）→ colligere（聚拢）→ 古法语 collecte → 现代英语 collect；同族词有 select（挑选）、elect（选举）、collection（收藏）等。

sensesIntro.en: Collect starts with gathering things and grows to people, money and a calm mind.
sensesIntro.cn: collect 从收集物品出发，扩展到集合人群、收钱与镇定心神。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: pulling scattered things into one place
core.cn: 核心意象：把散落的东西拢到一处

branches.en: Students lined up on the playground

intro.en: Collect sits in a big family built on the Latin root lect.
intro.cn: collect 属于以拉丁词根 lect 为核心的大词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root lect means to gather or choose.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 lect 意为收集、挑选。

items.example: Her coin collection fills two boxes.
items.exampleCN: 她的硬币收藏装满两个盒子。

items.example: The collector showed his old maps.
items.exampleCN: 收藏家展示了他收藏的旧地图。

items.example: Select the answer you think is right.
items.exampleCN: 选出你认为正确的答案。

items.example: We elect a class monitor every term.
items.exampleCN: 我们每学期选一次班长。

items.example: I cannot recollect his phone number.
items.exampleCN: 我记不起他的电话号码了。

items.example: The professor gave a lecture on birds.
items.exampleCN: 教授做了一场关于鸟类的讲座。

definition_en: a school where students study after secondary school, or part of a university
core_image: 中学之后继续读书的校园
scene: 哥哥收到录取信，全家都为他的大学开心。His dream is to study engineering at a good college.
sceneCN: 这里 college 是「学院；大学」（第 1 个义项：中学后的高等学校）；句意是他梦想在一所好学院学工程。

derivatives.zh: 由 college 加后缀构成，义为「学院的；大学的」
来自同一拉丁词根，义为「同事」

senses.title: A school after secondary school
senses.definition: a place where students study a subject after finishing secondary school
senses.definitionCN: 中学生毕业后继续学习的地方
senses.example: After senior high, Li Hua will go to college.
senses.exampleCN: 高中毕业后，李华将去上大学。
senses.why: The word names the next school up the ladder, where study becomes deeper.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指阶梯上更高一级的学校，学习内容更深。

senses.title: A part of a university
senses.definition: one of the parts inside a university, often with its own buildings and teachers
senses.definitionCN: 大学内部的组成部分，往往有独立的楼舍与师资
senses.example: Each college of the university has its own dining hall.
senses.exampleCN: 大学的每个学院都有自己的食堂。
senses.why: A big university splits into smaller houses so students feel at home.
senses.whyCN: 大大学分成小院落，让学生更有归属感，于是有了这个义项。

senses.title: A group with one job or duty
senses.definition: a group of people who share one profession or duty, such as an election college
senses.definitionCN: 承担同一职业或职责的人群，如选举团
senses.example: The election college meets to choose the president.
senses.exampleCN: 选举团开会选出总统。
senses.why: People who trained together were once called a college, so the word reached organised groups.
senses.whyCN: 曾经一起受过训练的人被称为 college，这个词便用到了有组织的团体上。

intro.en: College began as a word for people bound together, not buildings.
intro.cn: college 起初指「结合在一起的人」，而不是楼房。

items.en: Latin collega meant a person chosen to work with another, a partner in office.
items.cn: 拉丁语 collega 指被选出来与他人共事的人，即同僚。

items.en: Latin colligium later meant a body or society of such partners.
items.cn: 拉丁语 colligium 后来指这类人组成的团体。

items.en: Old French college meant an association or league of people.
items.cn: 古法语 college 指人的社团或联合会。

items.en: Middle English college first named groups of priests living under one roof.
items.cn: 中古英语 college 最初指住在同一屋檐下的教士团体。

items.en: Modern English college moved from religious groups to schools for higher study.
items.cn: 现代英语 college 从教士团体转指高等教育学校。

note.en: The first group collects same-root words; the second collects other schools above secondary level.
note.cn: 第一组收同根词，第二组收中学以上的其他学校。

entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「同事」，与 college 同源于拉丁语 collega。

entries.definition: A picture made of many pieces stuck together.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「拼贴画」，拼写与 college 相近但词源不同。
形容词，义为「学院的」，是 college 的形容词形式。

entries.definition: The highest school for study and research.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「大学」，规模通常比 college 更大。

entries.definition: A school for a special subject.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「专科院校；学会」。

entries.definition: A school or body for special study.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「学院；研究所」。

normalIntro.en: Remember college through its Latin partner and school life.
normalIntro.cn: 从拉丁「同僚」本义与校园生活记 college。

normal.en: colleague and college share the Latin root.
normal.cn: colleague 与 college 同一个拉丁词根。

normal.en: Many students say go to college.
normal.cn: 很多学生说 go to college。

normal.en: A university can contain many colleges.
normal.cn: 一所大学可以包含多个学院。

normal.en: college and collage differ in the last letters.
normal.cn: college 与 collage 结尾字母不同。

normal.en: College life starts with a campus card.
normal.cn: 大学生活从一张校园卡开始。

abstract.en: Picture partners walking through one gate together.
abstract.cn: 想象同窗伙伴一起走过同一扇校门。

abstract.en: See small houses inside a huge campus.
abstract.cn: 想象大学校园里的一座座小院。

abstract.en: Think of a ladder: middle school, then college.
abstract.cn: 想一架梯子：中学，然后是学院。

examples.en: My sister is a college student in Shanghai.
examples.cn: 我姐姐是上海的一名大学生。

examples.en: They worked hard so they could go to college together.
examples.cn: 他们努力学习，为的是能一起上大学。

examples.en: Our school team plays against the college team on Sunday.
examples.cn: 周日我们校队与学院队比赛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「考里几」——考进去要读「里」面好几「几」年，college 就是学院。

root: 拉丁语 com-（一起）+ legere（挑选）→ collega（同僚）→ colligium（团体）→ 古法语 college → 现代英语 college；同族词有 colleague（同事）、collegiate（学院的）。

sensesIntro.en: College grew from a group of partners into religious houses, then schools of higher study.
sensesIntro.cn: college 从「同僚团体」长成教士团体，再长成高等学府。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: people bound together for one study
core.cn: 核心意象：为同一学业结合在一起的人

intro.en: College belongs to the family built on Latin legere.
intro.cn: college 属于拉丁词根 legere 构成的词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root leg means to choose or gather.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 leg 意为挑选、聚集。

items.example: My colleague helps me with the report.
The collegiate library is very old.
I recollect our first school trip.
items.exampleCN: 我还记得我们第一次郊游。

items.example: He trains at a football academy.

definition_en: the quality that makes things red, blue, yellow and so on; also a verb meaning to add colour
core_image: 让世界不再灰白的红黄蓝
scene: 美术课上，同学们用蜡笔给春天的图画涂色。Let us colour the flowers in the picture.
sceneCN: 这里 colour 是动词「涂色」（第 3 个义项：给图画上颜色）；句意是给画里的花涂色。

derivatives.zh: 由 colour 加 -ful 构成，义为「多彩的；鲜艳的」
由 colour 加 -less 构成，义为「无色的；乏味的」
由 dis- 加 colour 构成，义为「使变色；褪色」
美式拼写，义为「颜色」

senses.title: Red, blue, yellow and the like
senses.definition: the appearance of things that makes them look red, blue, green and so on
senses.definitionCN: 使物体呈现红、蓝、绿等外观的性质
senses.example: What is your favourite colour at school?
senses.exampleCN: 在学校你最喜欢什么颜色？
senses.why: Light of different waves paints the world, and the look it gives is colour.
senses.whyCN: 不同波长的光给世界涂上外观，这个外观就是颜色。

senses.title: Paint or pigment
senses.definition: a substance you put on a surface to give it colour
senses.definitionCN: 涂在物体表面让它变色的物质
senses.example: Buy some colours for the art class.
senses.exampleCN: 为美术课买些颜料。
senses.why: The look can be kept in a tube, so the substance took the same name.
senses.whyCN: 这种外观能装进管子里保存，物质便借用了同一个名字。

senses.title: To add colour to something
senses.definition: to put colour on something with pencils, paint or markers
senses.definitionCN: 用铅笔、颜料或彩笔给东西上色
senses.example: Colour the sky blue in your drawing.
senses.exampleCN: 把画里的天空涂成蓝色。
senses.why: The noun moved into a verb the way many English nouns do.
senses.whyCN: 英语名词常直接转作动词，colour 也是如此。

senses.title: The healthy pink of the face
senses.definition: the natural red of someone's cheeks showing health
senses.definitionCN: 脸颊上显出健康的红色
senses.example: After the run, her face regained colour.
senses.exampleCN: 跑完步，她脸上恢复了血色。
senses.why: Colour shows life on a face as paint shows colour on a wall.
senses.whyCN: 颜料显色于墙，血色显色于脸，词义便这样迁移。

intro.en: Colour goes back to Latin words about covering and skin.
intro.cn: colour 可以追溯到拉丁语里表示「覆盖」「皮肤」的词。

items.en: Latin color meant colour or complexion; many link it to celare, to hide, as colour covers the surface.
items.cn: 拉丁语 color 指颜色、肤色；许多人把它与 celare（遮盖）相联系，因为颜色覆盖了表面。

items.en: Latin colorare meant to colour or give complexion.
items.cn: 拉丁语 colorare 意为着色、赋予肤色。

items.en: Old French colour carried the word into England.
items.cn: 古法语 colour 把这个词带进了英格兰。

items.en: Middle English colour meant both look and paint.
items.cn: 中古英语 colour 兼指外观与颜料。

items.en: Modern English kept colour in Britain and shortened it to color in the US.
items.cn: 现代英语英式保留 colour，美式简写为 color。

note.en: The first group collects words close in spelling; the second collects kinds of colour.
note.cn: 第一组收拼写相近的词，第二组收与颜色相关的词。

entries.definition: The part of a shirt round the neck.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「衣领」，与 colour 拼写相近但词源不同。
名词，义为「颜色」，是 colour 的美式拼法。
名词，义为「荣耀」，形近但词源不同。

entries.definition: Coloured liquid put on a surface.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「油漆；颜料」，与颜料义相近。

entries.definition: A substance giving colour to things.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「色素；颜料」，较专业的说法。

entries.definition: A slight shade of a colour.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「色调；淡色」。

normalIntro.en: Remember colour through the rainbow and the US spelling.
normalIntro.cn: 从彩虹与美式拼写两个角度记 colour。

normal.en: The US spelling color drops a u.
normal.cn: 美式拼写 color 少一个 u。

normal.en: Rainbows show seven colours.
normal.cn: 彩虹有七种颜色。

normal.en: colour and collar differ by one middle letter.
normal.cn: colour 与 collar 中间字母不同。

normal.en: colour pencils are used in art class.
normal.cn: 美术课用彩色铅笔。

normal.en: A colourful painting has many colours.
normal.cn: 多彩的画里颜色很多。

abstract.en: Picture a grey world suddenly painted bright.
abstract.cn: 想象灰色世界突然被涂亮。

abstract.en: See a brush dipping into a tube of red.
abstract.cn: 想象画笔蘸进一管红色。

abstract.en: Feel warm red rising into tired cheeks.
abstract.cn: 感觉红色回到疲惫的脸颊。

examples.en: Autumn gives the park beautiful colours.
examples.cn: 秋天给公园披上美丽的颜色。

examples.en: Please colour the tree green and the sun yellow.
examples.cn: 请把树涂成绿色、太阳涂成黄色。

examples.en: His face lost colour when he heard the news.
examples.cn: 听到消息后，他的脸失去了血色。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡勒」——蜡笔一按「卡勒」一声，颜色就涂上了，colour 就是颜色。

root: 拉丁语 color（颜色）→ colorare（着色）→ 古法语 colour → 中古英语 colour → 现代英语 colour（英式），美式拼作 color；同族词有 colourful（多彩的）、discolour（褪色）。

sensesIntro.en: Colour covers the look of light, the paint in tubes, the act of colouring and even the pink of cheeks.
sensesIntro.cn: colour 涵盖光的颜色、管中颜料、涂色动作，甚至脸颊血色。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the paint that covers a grey world
core.cn: 核心意象：让灰白世界变鲜艳的涂料

intro.en: Colour builds a family of bright words.
intro.cn: colour 衍生出一族与色彩有关的词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root color means colour.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 color 意为颜色。

items.example: The stage was colourful and bright.
items.exampleCN: 舞台五彩缤纷、明亮夺目。

items.meaning: to change colour in a bad way

items.example: The poster says color in the US.
His face turned pale with fear.
Which shade of blue do you like?
items.exampleCN: 你喜欢哪种色调的蓝色？

items.example: A rainbow appeared after the rain.

definition_en: to move towards the speaker or a place, or to arrive and happen
scene: 放学铃响了，妈妈正等在校门口。Come and see my new pencil box after school.
sceneCN: 这里 come 是「来」（第 1 个义项：向说话人靠近）；句意是放学后过来看新文具盒。

derivatives.zh: 由 be 加 come 构成，义为「变成」
由 well 加 come 构成，义为「欢迎」
由 in 加 come 构成，义为「收入」

senses.title: To move towards the speaker
senses.definition: to move towards the person speaking or towards a place
senses.definitionCN: 向说话的人或某个地点移动
senses.example: Please come to my desk with your book.
senses.exampleCN: 请拿着书到我桌边来。
senses.why: The oldest picture is simply footsteps moving closer.
senses.whyCN: 最原始的画面就是脚步声越来越近。

senses.title: To arrive at a place or state
senses.definition: to reach a place, level or state
senses.definitionCN: 抵达某地、某水平或某种状态
senses.example: The bus came at last after ten minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 十分钟后公交车终于来了。
senses.why: Once the footsteps are near, the goal is reached.
senses.whyCN: 脚步一旦靠近，目标也就抵达了。

senses.title: To happen or appear
senses.titleCN: 发生；出现（后接不定式或与形容词连用）
senses.definition: to begin to be, or to happen, often with other words like true or first
senses.definitionCN: 开始成为某状态或某情况发生，常与 true、first 等词连用
senses.example: Her dream of flying came true last summer.
senses.exampleCN: 她飞行的梦想去年夏天实现了。
senses.why: Arriving somewhere can also mean arriving at a result.
senses.whyCN: 到达某地也可以指到达某种结果。

senses.title: To have come from a place or family
senses.definition: to have your origin in a place, a family or a situation
senses.definitionCN: 出身于某地、某家庭或某种境况
senses.example: He comes from a small town near Chengdu.
senses.exampleCN: 他来自成都附近的一个小镇。
senses.why: The moving feet belong to someone with a starting point.
senses.whyCN: 移动的脚步总有起点，起点就是「来自」。

intro.en: Come is one of the oldest English verbs, from Germanic roots.
intro.cn: come 是英语最古老的动词之一，来自日耳曼语词根。

items.en: Germanic kwem- meant to move towards, shared across Germanic languages.
items.cn: 日耳曼语词根 kwem- 意为向某处移动，各日耳曼语言同源。

items.en: Old English cuman meant to come, arrive or move.
items.cn: 古英语 cuman 意为来、到达、移动。

items.en: Middle English comen kept all the old senses and added come true.
items.cn: 中古英语 comen 保留旧义，并发展出 come true 的用法。

items.en: Modern English come shortened the vowel and built phrasal uses like come on.
items.cn: 现代英语 come 缩短了元音，并发展出 come on 等短语用法。

items.en: Modern English also fixed the strange past form came.
items.cn: 现代英语还固定了特殊过去式 came。

note.en: The first group collects words of the come family; the second collects words of movement.
note.cn: 第一组收 come 词族，第二组收表示移动的词。

entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「变成」，由 be + come 构成。
动词，义为「欢迎」，由 well + come 构成。
名词，义为「收入」，由 in + come 构成。

entries.definition: To reach a place after travel.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「到达」，强调到达那一刻。
动词，义为「接近」，较正式。

entries.definition: To move away from the speaker.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「去」，与 come 方向相反。

normalIntro.en: Remember come through its family and its many phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 从词族与短语两个角度记 come。

normal.en: come back means return.
normal.cn: come back 意思是回来。

normal.en: come from shows where you were born.
normal.cn: come from 表示来自哪里。

normal.en: come on is used to cheer friends up.
normal.cn: come on 用来给朋友加油。

normal.en: become, welcome and income all hide come.
normal.cn: become、welcome 和 income 里都藏着 come。

normal.en: The past of come is came, not comed.
normal.cn: come 的过去式是 came，不是 comed。

abstract.en: Hear footsteps getting louder behind you.
abstract.cn: 听身后脚步声越来越近。

abstract.en: See a plane finally landing on time.
abstract.cn: 想象航班终于准点降落。

abstract.en: Watch a wish balloon rising and popping into reality.
abstract.cn: 看着愿望气球升空并成真。

examples.en: Come to the library with me after class.
examples.cn: 下课后和我一起去图书馆吧。

examples.en: My cousins come from Kunming every Spring Festival.
examples.cn: 我的表哥表姐每年春节从昆明过来。

examples.en: Keep practising and your wish will come true.
examples.cn: 坚持练习，你的愿望就会实现。

sensesIntro.en: Come moves from footsteps to arrival, results and origins.
sensesIntro.cn: come 从脚步移动延伸到到达、结果的达成与出身来源。

intro.cn: come 藏在好几个常用英语词里。

latinIntro.cn: come 本身是日耳曼词，不是拉丁词；它的词族靠添加小词构成。

definition_en: happening often, shared by many people, or ordinary and not special
core_image: 大家都有的、随处可见的
scene: 小区门口天天有人遛狗，几只金毛总能碰上。Pandas are rare but sparrows are common birds.
sceneCN: 这里 common 是「常见的」（第 1 个义项：经常出现、数量多）；句意是熊猫稀有而麻雀常见。

derivatives.zh: 由 common 加 -ly 构成，义为「通常；一般地」
由 common 加 -er 构成，义为「平民（旧用法）」
由 un- 加 common 构成，义为「不寻常的；罕见的」

senses.title: Seen or happening often
senses.definition: found or happening often and in many places
senses.definitionCN: 经常出现、到处都有的
senses.example: Colds are common in winter.
senses.exampleCN: 冬天感冒很常见。
senses.why: What belongs to many must show up everywhere, so the everyday look became the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 属于众人的东西自然到处出现，「常见」便成了第一义。

senses.title: Shared by two or more people
senses.definition: belonged to or shared by two or more people or groups
senses.definitionCN: 由两个或以上的人、群体共同拥有的
senses.example: Li Lei and I have English songs in common.
senses.exampleCN: 李雷和我都爱英文歌。
senses.why: The same root that means together also means shared.
senses.whyCN: 词根既有「一起」的意思，也就有了「共享」之义。

senses.title: Ordinary and not special
senses.definition: not special or unusual in any way
senses.definitionCN: 毫无特别之处的
senses.example: He is just a common student like us.
senses.exampleCN: 他只是个像我们一样的普通学生。
senses.why: What everyone has feels ordinary to each one.
senses.whyCN: 人人都有之物，在个人眼里便显得平凡。

senses.title: Belonging to the people as a whole
senses.definition: belonging to everyone in a community, as in common land
senses.definitionCN: 属于全体社区成员的，如公地
senses.example: Villagers let their sheep eat on the common grass.
senses.exampleCN: 村民让羊群在公地上吃草。
senses.why: Shared things widen to things shared by a whole village.
senses.whyCN: 「共享」的范围扩大到全村共有之物。

intro.en: Common comes from Latin words for sharing together.
intro.cn: common 来自拉丁语「共同分享」的词根。

items.en: Latin communis meant shared by all, public, from com- together and munis bound to serve.
items.cn: 拉丁语 communis 意为人人所共有的，来自 com-（一起）与 munis（尽义务的）。

items.en: Latin communia named things held in common.
items.cn: 拉丁语 communia 指共有之物。

items.en: Old French comun passed the word to England.
items.cn: 古法语 comun 把这个词传入英格兰。

items.en: Middle English commun covered shared, ordinary and public senses.
items.cn: 中古英语 commun 涵盖共有、普通、公共三层意思。

items.en: Modern English common built phrases like common sense and in common.
items.cn: 现代英语 common 衍生出 common sense、in common 等短语。

note.en: The first group collects the same-root family; the second collects words close in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组收同根词，第二组收近义词。

形容词，义为「通常的」。
形容词，义为「共享的」，与共同义相近。

normalIntro.en: Remember common through sharing and everyday life.
normalIntro.cn: 从「共享」与日常生活记 common。

normal.en: common, community and communicate share a root.
normal.cn: common、community 和 communicate 同词根。

normal.en: common sense means good everyday judgement.
normal.cn: common sense 指生活常识与判断力。

normal.en: in common means things shared together.
normal.cn: in common 表示彼此的共同之处。

normal.en: The commons is land for everyone.
normal.cn: commons 指大家共用的土地。

normal.en: common and uncommon are opposites.
normal.cn: common 与 uncommon 是反义词。

abstract.en: Picture a big table where everyone eats together.
abstract.cn: 想象大家围着一张大桌子吃饭。

abstract.en: See the same grey jacket on many people.
abstract.cn: 想象很多人穿着同款灰外套。

abstract.en: Hear a song everyone in class can sing.
abstract.cn: 听一首全班都会唱的歌。

examples.en: Misreading in haste is a common mistake in exams.
examples.cn: 匆忙中看错题是考试里常见的错误。

examples.en: Our class found many interests in common during the talk.
examples.cn: 聊天时我们班发现彼此有许多共同爱好。

examples.en: Riding a bike to school is common among students here.
examples.cn: 在这里，骑自行车上学在学生中很普遍。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡门」——同一条巷子里家家都「卡门」进进出出，common 就是常见的、共同的。

root: 拉丁语 com-（一起）+ munis（尽义务的）→ communis（共有的）→ 古法语 comun → 中古英语 commun → 现代英语 common；同族词有 community（社区）、communicate（交流）、communal（公共的）。

sensesIntro.en: Common runs from often-seen things to shared interests and public land.
sensesIntro.cn: common 从常见之物走向共同爱好与公共用地。

core.cn: 核心意象：被许多双手共同拥有的事物

intro.cn: common 处于「共享」词族的中心。

items.meaning: people living together in one place
items.example: Our community has a small library.
items.exampleCN: 我们社区有个小图书馆。

items.example: We communicate by phone every week.

definition_en: a business organisation, or the state of being with other people
core_image: 和你待在一起的人，或大家一起做事的机构
scene: 周五晚上，他不愿一个人待着，去找了同学。A big company will build a new school near our town.
sceneCN: 这里 company 是「公司」（第 1 个义项：企业组织）；句意是一家大公司要在镇附近建新学校。

derivatives.zh: 来自同一拉丁词根，义为「同伴；伙伴」
由 ac- 加 company 词根构成，义为「陪伴；伴随」
由 companion 加 -ship 构成，义为「友谊；陪伴之情」

senses.title: A business organisation
senses.definition: an organisation that makes or sells things, or offers services
senses.definitionCN: 制造、销售商品或提供服务的组织
senses.example: This company makes school bags for students.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司为学生生产书包。
senses.why: Bread eaten together started the word: a business is a group that works side by side.
senses.whyCN: 本义是「同吃一份面包的人」：公司就是并肩做事的群体。

senses.title: Being with someone so you are not alone
senses.definition: the state of being with another person
senses.definitionCN: 与他人相处、不孤单的状态
senses.example: Your company makes the long trip pleasant.
senses.exampleCN: 有你的陪伴，长途旅行也变得愉快。
senses.why: Having someone with you is the heart of the old meaning.
senses.whyCN: 「有人与你同在」正是这个词古老本义的核心。

senses.title: Guests or visitors
senses.definition: people who are visiting your home
senses.definitionCN: 到你家来做客的人
senses.example: We have company tonight, so tidy your room.
senses.exampleCN: 今晚有客人来，把房间收拾好。
senses.why: Guests are people who share your table, so the eating-together idea returned.
senses.whyCN: 客人就是与你同桌的人，「同食」之义在这里回归。

senses.title: A group such as soldiers or actors
senses.definition: a group of soldiers or performers working together
senses.definitionCN: 一起行动的士兵或演员团体
senses.example: The drama company will stage our play.
senses.exampleCN: 剧团将上演我们的话剧。
senses.why: Any group standing together keeps the old togetherness.
senses.whyCN: 凡并肩而立的群体都保留了「在一起」的古义。

intro.en: Company began with bread: people who eat together.
intro.cn: company 起于「面包」：同吃一锅饭的人。

items.en: Latin panis meant bread, the base of the story.
items.cn: 拉丁语 panis 意为面包，是这个词故事的起点。

items.en: Late Latin companio meant one who shares bread with you, a mate.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 companio 指与你分享面包的人，即同伴。

items.en: Old French compaignie meant a group of companions or fellowship.
items.cn: 古法语 compaignie 指一群同伴或伙伴关系。

items.en: Middle English companye meant fellowship, guests and groups of workers.
items.cn: 中古英语 companye 涵盖伙伴、宾客与工人团体。

items.en: Modern English company fixed the business sense as firms grew.
items.cn: 现代英语随着公司兴起把商业义项固定下来。

note.cn: 第一组收同根词，第二组收近义词。

entries.definition: A separate section of a space.

entries.definition: The pleasant feeling of having a companion.

normalIntro.en: Remember company through shared bread and shared work.
normalIntro.cn: 从「同食面包」与「并肩工作」记 company。

normal.en: com- means together and panis means bread.
normal.cn: com- 表示一起，panis 表示面包。

normal.en: companion and company share a root.
normal.cn: companion 与 company 同词根。

normal.en: keep someone company means stay with them.
normal.cn: keep someone company 指陪伴某人。

normal.en: A company is also called a firm.
normal.cn: 公司也可以叫 firm。

normal.en: The plural of company is companies.
normal.cn: company 的复数是 companies。

abstract.en: Picture friends breaking one loaf of bread.
abstract.cn: 想象朋友们分食一块面包。

abstract.en: See workers walking into one big gate.
abstract.cn: 想象工人们走进同一扇大门。

abstract.en: Feel a warm shoulder beside you on a long walk.
abstract.cn: 感觉长途跋涉中有肩膀在旁。

examples.en: My uncle works for a car company in Ningbo.
examples.cn: 我叔叔在宁波一家汽车公司上班。

examples.en: Come over and keep me company while I wait for the doctor.
examples.cn: 来陪我一下，我在等医生。

examples.en: We have company for dinner tonight.
examples.cn: 今晚我们有客人来吃饭。

sensesIntro.en: Company moves from bread-mates to guests, troops, actors and businesses.
sensesIntro.cn: company 从「分食面包的同伴」走向宾客、连队、剧团与企业。

items.example: My dog is my best companion.
Mum keeps flour in the pantry.
items.exampleCN: 妈妈把面粉放在储藏室。

items.example: A troop marched past the square.
The school ensemble plays on Friday.

definition_en: to look at two or more things to see how they are alike or different
core_image: 把两样东西并排放在一起看
scene: 科学课上，他把两片叶子的叶脉对在一起看。Please compare the two photos and find the differences.
sceneCN: 这里 compare 是「比较；对照」（第 1 个义项：找异同）；句意是比较两张照片找出不同。

derivatives.zh: 由 compare 加 -ison 构成，义为「比较；对照」
由 compare 加 -able 构成，义为「可比较的；比得上的」
由 compare 加 -ative 构成，义为「比较的；相对的」

senses.title: To look at things side by side
senses.definition: to examine two or more things to find how they are alike or different
senses.definitionCN: 查看两个或以上事物，找出它们的异同
senses.example: Compare the two answers and correct your own.
senses.exampleCN: 对比两个答案，改正你自己的。
senses.why: The prefix com- means together and par means equal: you put two things as equals to look closely.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 com- 表示「一起」，词根 par 表示「对等」，即把两物摆到同等位置细看。

senses.title: To say one thing is like another
senses.definition: to describe one thing as being like another
senses.definitionCN: 说一物像另一物
senses.example: Poets compare life to a long river.
senses.exampleCN: 诗人把人生比作长河。
senses.why: Putting two things together also lets you match them in words.
senses.whyCN: 把两物放在一起，也就能用语言把它们对上。

senses.title: To be as good as something
senses.definition: to be nearly as good as someone or something else
senses.definitionCN: 质量、水平接近某人某物
senses.example: No other cake can compare with Grandma's.
senses.exampleCN: 没有哪种蛋糕比得上奶奶做的。
senses.why: Once compared, things stand equal or unequal.
senses.whyCN: 一经比较，事物便分出高低对等。

senses.title: To exchange ideas or reports
senses.definition: to share and check ideas or figures with others
senses.definitionCN: 与他人互相对照各自的看法或数据
senses.example: After the test, we compared notes in pairs.
senses.exampleCN: 考完后我们两人一组对笔记。
senses.why: Two sets of notes laid side by side are being compared.
senses.whyCN: 两份笔记并排放在一起，正是在互相比较。

intro.en: Compare is built on Latin words for equal.
intro.cn: compare 建立在拉丁语「对等」的词根之上。

items.en: Latin par meant equal, seen in pair and parity.
items.cn: 拉丁语 par 意为对等，见于 pair、parity。

items.en: Latin comparare meant to pair things up or match them.
items.cn: 拉丁语 comparare 意为把东西配成对、加以匹配。

items.en: Old French comparer carried the matching sense.
items.cn: 古法语 comparer 传下了「匹配」之义。

items.en: Middle English comparen meant to match, liken and be equal.
items.cn: 中古英语 comparen 涵盖匹配、比作与相等之义。

items.en: Modern English compare grew the study phrase compare with and compare to.
items.cn: 现代英语 compare 发展出 compare with 与 compare to 的用法区别。

entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「把…比作」，较文雅。

normalIntro.en: Remember compare through its equal root and classroom habits.
normalIntro.cn: 从「对等」词根与课堂习惯记 compare。

normal.en: com- means together and par means equal.
normal.cn: com- 表示一起，par 表示对等。

normal.en: pair and parity also come from par.
normal.cn: pair 与 parity 也来自 par。

normal.en: compare with looks at both; compare to praises one as the other.
normal.cn: compare with 是对比，compare to 是比作。

normal.en: compare notes means swap ideas.
normal.cn: compare notes 指交换意见。

senses.title: To finish something you are doing
senses.definition: to finish making or doing something so it is ready

senses.example: She completed her homework before dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 晚饭前她做完了作业。
senses.why: The prefix com- means thoroughly and plere means to fill: fill it up fully and it is done.

senses.title: Having all necessary parts
senses.definition: having every part that is needed

senses.example: This is a complete set of chess pieces.
senses.exampleCN: 这是一套齐全的国际象棋棋子。
senses.why: What is filled to the brim lacks nothing, so it is whole.
senses.whyCN: 被填满的东西毫无欠缺，因此是完整的。

senses.title: Total and without exception
senses.definition: used to stress that something is total, as in complete silence
senses.definitionCN: 强调某情况达到顶点，如一片寂静

senses.exampleCN: 教室里一片寂静。
senses.why: Fullness pushed to the limit becomes absoluteness.

senses.exampleCN: 在表格里填上姓名和班级。

senses.whyCN: 补上缺口正是拉丁词根所描述的动作。

abstract.en: Watch water rise to the brim of a glass.

senses.definitionCN: 乐手或歌手为观众公开演奏、演唱的活动
senses.example: The band played at our school concert.
senses.exampleCN: 乐队在我们的校园音乐会上演出。

senses.why: The old meaning of agreeing or uniting survives in this phrase.
senses.whyCN: 「商定、联合」的旧义在这个短语里留存下来。

examples.cn: 小提琴音乐会的门票一天就售罄了。

definition_en: the state something is in, or something that must be true before another thing happens
scene: 跑道被雨水泡软了，大家都担心赛况。The track is in poor condition after the heavy rain.
sceneCN: 这里 condition 是「状况」（第 1 个义项：事物所处的状态）；句意是大雨后跑道状况很差。

senses.title: The state something is in
senses.definition: the physical state of a person, thing or place
senses.definitionCN: 人或物所处的实际状态
senses.example: The old bike is still in good condition.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆旧自行车状况仍然良好。
senses.why: Latin condicere means to agree or settle: what has been settled is the present state.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 condicere 意为商定：既定之事，即当下的状态。

senses.title: Something that must be agreed first
senses.definition: a rule or fact that must be true before something else can happen
senses.definitionCN: 某事发生前必须满足的规则或事实
senses.example: He agreed to lend the book on condition that I return it on Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 他同意借书，条件是我周五归还。
senses.why: Before an agreement settles, its terms are listed as conditions.
senses.whyCN: 协议敲定之前，各项要求便称为条件。

senses.title: The situation around people
senses.definition: the conditions around you, such as weather or work situation
senses.definitionCN: 周围的天气、工作等整体情形
senses.example: The players played well in hot conditions.
senses.exampleCN: 球员们在炎热的天气条件下表现出色。
senses.why: One state widens to the whole set of surrounding states.
senses.whyCN: 单一状态扩大到周围一整圈状态。

senses.title: An illness that lasts a long time

definition_en: to join two things together, or to have a link between people or ideas
core_image: 把两根线头接成一条通路
scene: 信息课上，他把网线插进教室的路由器。Please connect your tablet to the school wifi.
sceneCN: 这里 connect 是「连接」（第 1 个义项：把两物接通）；句意是把平板连到校园网。

senses.title: To join two things physically
senses.definition: to join two things so they touch or work together
senses.definitionCN: 把两样东西接在一起使其相通
senses.example: Connect the two pipes with this joint.
senses.exampleCN: 用这个接头把两根管子接起来。
senses.why: The Latin prefix con- means together and nectere means to bind: tie two things into one.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 con- 表示「一起」，nectere 表示「捆扎」，即把两物系成一体。

senses.title: To link ideas, people or events
senses.definition: to see or make a relationship between ideas, people or events
senses.definitionCN: 在想法、人或事之间建立关联
senses.example: The story connects our town with an old legend.
senses.exampleCN: 这个故事把我们小镇与古老传说联系起来。
senses.why: Binding works on thoughts and people just as on ropes.
senses.whyCN: 绳结可以捆物，也可以把人与想法「捆」在一起。

senses.title: To join a network or power line
senses.definition: to attach a device to electricity, the internet or a phone line
senses.definitionCN: 把设备接上电源、网络或电话线
senses.example: My phone connects to the internet only at home.
senses.exampleCN: 我的手机只在家里能连上网络。
senses.why: Modern life simply binds machines into bigger webs.
senses.whyCN: 现代生活只是把机器系进更大的网。

senses.title: To feel close to someone
senses.definition: to feel that you understand and like someone
senses.definitionCN: 觉得自己理解并喜欢对方
senses.example: They connected quickly on the first school day.
senses.exampleCN: 开学第一天他们就很快亲近起来。
senses.why: Two hearts tied together are connected, too.
senses.whyCN: 心被系在一起，也是「连接」。

definition_en: to think carefully about something before deciding, or to believe something is true
core_image: 捧着问题在心里反复掂量
scene: 选社团前，他把时间和兴趣都摆在心里称了称。Consider joining the science club this term.
sceneCN: 这里 consider 是「考虑」（第 1 个义项：认真思索再决定）；句意是考虑一下这学期加入科学社。

derivatives.zh: 由 consider 加 -ation 构成，义为「考虑；体贴」

senses.title: To think carefully before deciding
senses.definition: to think about something carefully in order to decide
senses.definitionCN: 为了做决定而认真思考
senses.example: We considered moving the match to Saturday.
senses.exampleCN: 我们考虑过把比赛挪到周六。
senses.why: The Latin prefix con- means together and sidus means star: you study the stars together to plan your move.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 con- 表示「一起」，sidus 表示「星辰」，古人合观星辰以定行止。

senses.title: To believe something is a fact
senses.definition: to have an opinion that something is true or of a kind
senses.definitionCN: 持有某物为真或属某类的看法
senses.example: Most students consider the library the quietest place.
senses.exampleCN: 大多数学生认为图书馆是最安静的地方。
senses.why: Weighing a thing in the mind fixes where you place it.
senses.whyCN: 在心里掂量过后，你会给它安个位置。

senses.title: To think about others' needs
senses.definition: to pay attention to other people's feelings or needs
senses.definitionCN: 注意到别人的感受与需要
senses.example: A good captain considers every player's energy.
senses.exampleCN: 好队长会顾及每位队员的体力。
senses.why: Careful thinking naturally includes the people around you.
senses.whyCN: 认真思考自然会把身边的人算进去。

senses.title: To look at with attention
senses.definition: to observe something thoughtfully
senses.definitionCN: 聚精会神地观察某物
senses.example: The old painter considered the sketch for a long time.
senses.exampleCN: 老画家对着草图端详了很久。
senses.why: The earliest sense was the eyes, before the mind took over.
senses.whyCN: 最初义在眼，后来才移到心。

definition_en: to keep doing something or to go on without stopping
scene: 下起小雨，运动会还是照常进行。The players continued running in the light rain.
sceneCN: 这里 continue 是「继续」（第 1 个义项：不停下）；句意是选手们冒着小雨继续奔跑。

senses.title: To keep doing something
senses.definition: to start again or keep doing something after a pause
senses.definitionCN: 停顿后再接着做或持续做某事
senses.example: After the break, we continued the experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 休息之后，我们继续做实验。
senses.why: The Latin prefix con- means together and tenere means to hold: hold everything together and do not let go.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 con- 表示「一起」，tenere 表示「握住」，把一切握住不放便是不停。

senses.title: To go on existing or happening
senses.definition: to last or keep happening over a period of time
senses.definitionCN: 在某段时间内不停发生或存在
senses.example: The hot weather continued all week.
senses.exampleCN: 炎热天气持续了一整周。
senses.why: What is held tight does not end quickly.
senses.whyCN: 握得紧的东西不会很快结束。

senses.title: To go on speaking or moving after a stop
senses.definition: to start again after stopping, as in speech or travel
senses.definitionCN: 在言语或行进停顿之后重新开始
senses.example: He paused, then continued with his story.
senses.exampleCN: 他停了停，接着讲他的故事。
senses.why: A held breath released returns to the same sentence.
senses.whyCN: 屏住的呼吸一放，还是回到同一句话。

senses.title: To move to the next part
senses.definition: to pass from one part of a book, list or trip to the next
senses.definitionCN: 从书、清单或旅程的一部分进入下一部分
senses.example: Continue to page ten for the answers.
senses.exampleCN: 答案请翻到第十页。
senses.why: Holding the thread means walking from one part into the next.
senses.whyCN: 握住线头，自然从这一段走到下一段。

entries.definition: To keep going for a time.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「持续」，侧重时长。
短语动词，义为「继续进行」，较口语。

entries.definition: To start again after a stop.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「重新开始」，较正式。

normalIntro.cn: 从「握住不放」的角度记 continue。

normal.en: tenere means to hold; con- means together.
normal.cn: tenere 意为握住，con- 表示一起。

normal.en: contain and continue share the root.
normal.cn: contain 与 continue 同词根。

normal.en: to be continued ends a TV episode.
normal.cn: 连续剧常用 to be continued 表示「未完待续」。

normal.en: continue doing and continue to do both work.
normal.cn: continue doing 与 continue to do 都正确。

normal.en: continuous describes non-stop rain.
normal.cn: continuous 形容下个不停的雨。

abstract.en: Feel fingers gripping a rope in a long climb.
abstract.cn: 感觉攀爬中攥紧绳子的手指。

abstract.en: See a story book stopping at page one hundred.
abstract.cn: 想象故事书停在第一百页。

abstract.en: Hear rain tapping the window all week.
abstract.cn: 听雨点整周敲着窗户。

examples.en: Continue reading where you stopped last night.
examples.cn: 从昨晚停下的地方接着读。

examples.en: The music continued long after the concert ended.
examples.cn: 音乐会散场后乐声仍久久回荡。

examples.en: Keep trying and continue until the finish line.
examples.cn: 坚持住，一直跑到终点线。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肯踢牛」——再累也「肯踢牛」般一步不停，continue 就是继续。

root: 拉丁语 con-（一起）+ tenere（握住）→ continuus（连续的）→ continuare（使不间断）→ 古法语 continuer → 中古英语 continuen → 现代英语 continue；同族词有 contain（包含）、continuous（连续的）、tenant（租户）。

sensesIntro.en: Continue holds on to actions, weather, speech and the next page.
sensesIntro.cn: continue「握住不放」：接着做、持续着、接着讲、翻下页。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand that refuses to let go
core.cn: 核心意象：一只不肯松开的手

intro.en: Continue belongs to the ten family of holding words.
intro.cn: continue 属于表示「握持」的 ten 词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root ten means to hold.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 ten 意为握住。

items.meaning: the next part of a story
items.example: The film left room for a continuation.
Three days of continuous rain flooded the road.
The show keeps continuity between episodes.
items.exampleCN: 这部剧每集之间很连贯。

items.meaning: a person who holds a rented home
to go on for a time

items.example: The match resumed after the rain.

definition_zh: 控制；管理；操纵；（遥控器等的）控制器
definition_en: to make someone or something do what you want, or the power to do this
core_image: 手握方向盘或遥控器的那只手
scene: 遥控赛车在操场上飞驰，他指哪儿车去哪儿。Learn to control your temper when playing games.
sceneCN: 这里 control 是「控制」（第 1 个义项：约束自己的行为情绪）；句意是打游戏时学会控制脾气。

derivatives.zh: 由 control 加 -er 构成，义为「控制器；管理员」
由 control 加 -able 构成，义为「可控的」
由 un- 加 controllable 构成，义为「无法控制的」

senses.title: To direct or limit something
senses.definition: to make something behave the way you want
senses.definitionCN: 让事物按你的意愿运作
senses.example: Control your speed on the downhill.
senses.exampleCN: 下坡时控制好车速。
senses.why: The Medieval Latin phrase contra rotulum meant a counter-roll used to check records: checking became ruling.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪拉丁语 contra rotulum 指用于核对的副本卷册，「核对」引申为「掌控」。

senses.title: To hold back feelings
senses.definition: to stop yourself from showing anger, fear or excitement
senses.definitionCN: 克制怒气、恐惧或兴奋
senses.example: He could not control his laughter in class.
senses.exampleCN: 他在课上忍不住笑出声来。
senses.why: Rules that govern machines can also govern feelings.
senses.whyCN: 管机器的规矩同样能管住情绪。

senses.title: The power to direct something
senses.definition: the ability or right to decide how something works
senses.definitionCN: 支配事物运作的能力或权力
senses.example: The coach has full control of the training plan.
senses.exampleCN: 教练全权掌握训练计划。
senses.why: The act of ruling becomes the power itself.
senses.whyCN: 「掌控」的动作沉淀为「权力」本身。

senses.title: A device that operates a machine
senses.definition: a tool or set of buttons used to work a machine
senses.definitionCN: 操控机器的工具或按键组
senses.example: The game control fits small hands well.
senses.exampleCN: 这款游戏手柄很适合小手。
senses.why: The power sits in your hands, so the tool took the name.
senses.whyCN: 权力握在手里，操控工具便借用了这个名字。

intro.en: Control began with a second scroll used to check the first.
intro.cn: control 起于「用副本卷册核对正本」。

items.en: Medieval Latin contrarotulus meant a counter-roll, a copy used for checking accounts.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 contrarotulus 指核对账目用的副本卷册。

items.en: Old French controle meant checking against a register.
items.cn: 古法语 controle 指对照登记册核查。

items.en: Middle English controle first meant official checking of accounts.
items.cn: 中古英语 controle 起初指对账目的官方核查。

items.en: Middle English controle later meant restraining and commanding people.
items.cn: 中古英语 controle 后来指约束与指挥。

items.en: Modern English control added machines, feelings and devices.
items.cn: 现代英语 control 又覆盖机器、情绪与控制器。

note.en: The first group collects words close in spelling; the second collects words close in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组收拼写相近的词，第二组收近义词。

entries.definition: A device or person that controls.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「控制器；管理员」，与 control 同根。
形容词，义为「可控的」，同根派生词。

entries.definition: Not an English word; beware of the spelling.
entries.definitionCN: 并非英语单词，注意与 control 区分拼写。
名词，义为「对比」，形近但词源不同。

entries.definition: To run or handle something well.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「管理；设法做到」。
动词，义为「操作」，多指机器。

entries.definition: To order or direct with authority.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「指挥；命令」。

normalIntro.en: Remember control through checking rolls and steady hands.
normalIntro.cn: 从「核对卷册」与「稳住的手」记 control。

normal.en: control once meant a copy roll for checking.
normal.cn: control 曾指用于核对的副本卷册。

normal.en: under control means safe and managed.
normal.cn: under control 表示在掌控之中。

normal.en: A remote control works from far away.
normal.cn: 遥控器能远距离操作。

normal.en: The double l appears in controlled and controlling.
normal.cn: controlled 与 controlling 中 l 要双写。

normal.en: control and contrast differ in the middle letters.
normal.cn: control 与 contrast 中间字母不同。

abstract.en: Grip the steering wheel of a bumper car.
abstract.cn: 紧握碰碰车的方向盘。

abstract.en: Breathe slowly to cool a hot temper.
abstract.cn: 深呼吸让火气降温。

abstract.en: See a single button steer a whole toy car.
abstract.cn: 想象一个按键指挥整辆玩具车。

examples.en: Keep the ball under control during the dribble.
examples.cn: 运球时把球控制在自己脚下。

examples.en: She controlled her nerves before the piano contest.
examples.cn: 钢琴比赛前她控制住了紧张情绪。

examples.en: The pilot kept full control of the plane in the storm.
examples.cn: 风暴中飞行员牢牢掌控着飞机。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肯抽喽」——肯上手就能抽着缰绳喽，control 就是控制。

root: 中世纪拉丁语 contra（相对）+ rotulus（卷册）→ contrarotulus（核对用的副本）→ 古法语 controle（核查）→ 中古英语 controle → 现代英语 control；同族词有 controller（控制器）、controllable（可控的）、roll（卷册）。

sensesIntro.en: Control runs from checking records to ruling, restraining and buttons in hand.
sensesIntro.cn: control 从「核对」长成掌管、克制与手中的按键。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady hand that decides what happens next
core.cn: 核心意象：决定下一步的稳稳的手

intro.en: Control keeps a family of ruling and checking words.
intro.cn: control 围绕「掌管与核对」形成词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root contra rotulus means a counter-roll for checking.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 contra rotulus 意为核对用的副本卷册。

items.example: The drone is easy controllable for beginners.
items.exampleCN: 无人机对新手来说很容易操控。
自控力对考试很有帮助。
质检环节检测每件玩具。
